title: Autophagy Modulation with Hydroxychloroquine in BRAF-Mutated Refractory Colorectal Cancer
brief_summary: Clinical trial 7 for Metastatic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma. This is a Phase 2 study.
detailed_description: This clinical trial evaluates the efficacy and safety of investigational therapy for Metastatic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma. Participants will be assessed for response, progression-free survival, and overall survival.
inclusion_criteria: Metastatic BRAF V600E-mutated Colorectal Cancer; Progression on at least 1 prior line (refractory); ECOG PS 0-1; Adequate organ function
exclusion_criteria: Prior chemotherapy ≤14 days; Symptomatic leptomeningeal disease; Recent MI or coronary syndromes
eligibility_criteria: Metastatic BRAF V600E-mutated Colorectal Cancer; Progression on at least 1 prior line (refractory); ECOG PS 0-1; Adequate organ function. Exclusion: Prior chemotherapy ≤14 days; Symptomatic leptomeningeal disease; Recent MI or coronary syndromes
